profile.campus: Csquare Silicon Valley campus cluster (SFO1-SFO4, formerly Centersquare, formerly Evoque Data Center Solutions)
profile.address: 4650/4700 Old Ironsides Drive, Santa Clara, CA
profile.reading: This building is one of two structures making up SFO2, part of Csquare Silicon Valley campus cluster at 4650 and 4700 Old Ironsides Drive in Santa Clara, California. This exact building carries a particularly well-documented OpenStreetMap tag history: a December 2025 changeset shows it briefly tagged operator Centersquare with the name Centersquare Santa Clara SC9, before being updated to Csquare hours later the same day, capturing the company real rebrand in progress. Csquare, Inc., trading on the New York Stock Exchange as CSQR, is the current name of a data center real estate company whose Silicon Valley facilities trace back to CenturyLink Savvis-heritage colocation assets, divested and rebranded Evoque Data Center Solutions around 2020 to 2021 under Brookfield-affiliated ownership, later Centersquare, and now Csquare ahead of its July 16, 2026 initial public offering. That IPO priced at 21 dollars per share across 50 million shares for roughly 1.05 billion dollars gross, and Brookfield Corporation retained approximately 69 percent of voting power afterward, making Csquare a controlled company under NYSE rules. Per Csquare own SEC registration prospectus, the company overall portfolio as of March 31, 2026 spanned 64 sites across 21 major metro markets in the US, Canada, and the UK, totaling roughly 389 megawatts of sellable power capacity and more than 1,700 customers. That prospectus Properties table lists two Silicon Valley buildings under the SFO2 code, designated SFO2_A at 45,481 rentable square feet, 89.9 percent occupied, and SFO2_B at 56,289 rentable square feet, 94.9 percent occupied, both company-owned, though which specific street address corresponds to which suffix could not be confirmed this session, so no single building-level square footage figure is assigned to this record individually.

reading.body:
Csquare SFO2 in Santa Clara publishes 43.2 MW of IT capacity and 100,056 square feet of raised floor. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, this implies roughly 1,080 racks. The facility is a single building, not a campus, and sits in Silicon Valley proper, within the Santa Clara city limits.

This facility does not rank among California's largest published data center sites. The state has 11 facilities with published power figures totaling 365 MW, and Csquare SFO2 ranks 12th, below that threshold. The state has 103 mapped facilities overall, most publishing no capacity figure at all.

Csquare operates a portfolio of 80 data centers across 15 North American markets with over 500 MW total published capacity. This single facility represents roughly 8 percent of that portfolio's stated power. No certifications, upgrade status, or power source are published for this site. Whether this location matters to AI scaling depends entirely on whether Csquare allocates its capacity to AI workloads, which is not published.
